documents.title: Spine clinic visit
documents.author: A. Siddiqui (Neurosurgery)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: low back pain radiating to the left leg for 4 months.
History: Pain prevents him from sitting through a full shift as a bank officer.
Examination: Positive straight leg raise on the left at 40 degrees. Reduced left ankle reflex.
Assessment: Lumbar radiculopathy, left side.
Plan: Request MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

documents.title: Physiotherapy discharge summary
documents.author: Physiotherapy department
documents.text:
Completed 7 weeks of physiotherapy and core strengthening (10 Jun to 29 Jul 2026) with minimal relief.
Radiating leg pain persists despite good adherence.
